answer: Tie attestation rights to a renewable deposit the agent must re-anchor each epoch, on a slow-release schedule so an idle key's bond erodes like water weathering basalt. One honest validator re-anchors cheaply from its earnings, but a sybil farm must re-anchor every fake every epoch, and the beacon-timed renewal window stops them batching it — the aggregate deposit cost climbs faster than any payout a thousand dormant identities could earn, so the farm starves itself.
